_source: Unity export GameServerConfig.asset::Cosmetics + CosmeticConfig assets; price gate verified in GameAssembly.dll PlayerSave$$PurchaseCosmetics_S. Prices are Premium currency (supporter currency; icon cosmetic-icons/premium.webp). Excluded: Hidden entries + Exclusive supporter/founder items (server rejects Price==0 OR Exclusive!=0). Regenerate: spiritvale-build dev/extract_cosmetics.py

items.name: Bandit Wrap
items.desc: Leather wrapped tight for dust, trouble, and quick escapes.

items.name: Banner Helm
items.desc: Orange cloth marks the one others follow.

items.name: Beast Hood
items.desc: Gaping jaws make this hood look hungry.

items.name: Beast Pelt Hood
items.desc: Rugged hide wraps close, wild and untamed.

items.name: Bishop's Hood
items.desc: Blue and gold rise tall for solemn rites.

items.name: Bronze Visage
items.desc: Stoic bronze hides the face and keeps its secrets.

items.name: Bullcrest Helm
items.desc: Red cloth and proud horn promise strength and protection.

items.name: Crimson Plume
items.desc: Ruby feathers draw every eye before the first weapon moves.

items.name: Demon Hood
items.desc: Violet horns whisper dark ambition, then pretend they said nothing.

items.name: Doom Crown
items.desc: Regret-dark metal and a crimson spike make betrayal feel ceremonial.

items.name: Dragon Hood
items.desc: Scaled plates glare forward, making polite conversations much harder nearby.

items.name: Dragonspire Helm
items.desc: This helm suggests dragon-slaying confidence, even when confidence came separately.

items.name: Emerald Crown
items.desc: One verdant gem softens the gold, regal without losing warmth.

items.name: Falcon Hood
items.desc: Feathers shape the hood for scouts who enjoy looking judgmental.

items.name: Feathered Crown
items.desc: Jade plumes rise from the crown, bright with old forest ceremony.

items.name: Festival Cap
items.desc: Bright red cloth brings celebration, cheer, and mild hat confidence.

items.name: Festival Turtle Cap
items.desc: Turtle charm and tassels promise luck, patience, and a great time.

items.name: Fur Hood
items.desc: A thick fur-lined hood. Keeps the wearer warm in the coldest regions.

items.name: Gentleman's Hat
items.desc: Sharp blue style says trouble may arrive, but properly dressed.

items.name: Golden Crest
items.desc: Polished gold announces the champion's presence before the wearer proves anything.

items.name: Hermit Hood
items.desc: Plain brown cloth helps wanderers avoid people, questions, and invitations.

items.name: Horned Vanguard
items.desc: Curved horns add authority, intimidation, and several doorway problems.

items.name: Hunter's Hood
items.desc: Green cloth blends with brush, helping scouts look responsible.

items.name: Iron Guard Helm
items.desc: Orange trim adds style to the business of being hit.

items.name: Jester Hat
items.desc: That glowing rune at the front suggests the joke may be on someone else.

items.name: Legionnaire Helm
items.desc: The red plume says valor; the dents say experience.

items.name: Mystic Hat
items.desc: Classic wizard shape, faint sparks, and absolutely no subtlety whatsoever.

items.name: Nomad Hood
items.desc: Blue tassel and rough leather fight sunburn with desert style.

items.name: Quillcap
items.desc: A jaunty feather at the top encourages stylish escapes and questionable confidence.

items.name: Raider Helm
items.desc: Horned metal promises raids, bruises, and very limited apologies.

items.name: Regal Tricorne
items.desc: Naval authority sits neatly on your head and expects respect.

items.name: Sailor Cap
items.desc: Crisp blue cloth suggests nautical competence, even on dry land.

items.name: Scholar's Cap
items.desc: Teal cloth and a golden emblem make apprentices look prepared.

items.name: Seer's Hood
items.desc: The eye motif promises visions, whether you wanted them or not.

items.name: Sharpened Visor
items.desc: Angular plates glare outward, because subtle intimidation was unavailable.

items.name: Sky Raider Hat
items.desc: Tinted goggles promise exploration, speed, and terrible plans.

items.name: Skywing Mask
items.desc: Silver curves hum with wind-blessed grace and divine lift overhead.

items.name: Spiked Helm
items.desc: Gladiators love helmets that introduce themselves before the wearer does.

items.name: Straw Hat
items.desc: Sturdy straw protects farmers, pirates, and anyone avoiding sunburn outside.

items.name: Sun Emblem Helm
items.desc: Twin wings and a dawn crest mark those who shield others.

items.name: Tiger Hat
items.desc: A striped helm shaped like a tiger's head. Radiates ferocity and predatory strength.

items.name: Totem Skull Headdress
items.desc: A spirit skull crowns the headdress, warning allies and enemies alike.

items.name: Trickster Horns
items.desc: Small devil horns announce mischief before the prank even begins.

items.name: Valor Helm
items.desc: Polished curves speak of earned honor, not empty arrogance alone.

items.name: Voidspike Helm
items.desc: Purple spikes handle intimidation better than any glare.

items.name: Worker's Cap
items.desc: Plain grey cloth belongs to people who keep the world moving.

items.name: 3DGlasses
items.desc: A set of red and blue glasses that makes your vision blurry. You have no idea what they could be used for.

items.name: Cardboard Chick
items.desc: Cardboard courage stares forward bravely, despite knowing exactly what it is made of.

items.name: Ceremonial Mask
items.desc: An ornate mask used in ancient rituals. Rumored to ward off evil spirits.

items.name: Cotton Mask
items.desc: Dust, sneezes, and awkward alley smells meet their soft cotton rival.

items.name: Funny Glasses
items.desc: You feel a bit more private with these on. You now have an impressive mustache.

items.name: Heartgaze Shades
items.desc: Heart lenses deflect rejection, or at least make it easier to endure.

items.name: Round Glasses
items.desc: A set of sophisticated glasses that are sure to make you look smart.

items.name: Starshine Glasses
items.desc: Star lenses reflect dreams, light, and probably your poor decisions.

items.name: Stylish Shades
items.desc: These glasses shine with golden frames and make you see red.

items.name: Sunglasses
items.desc: A set of cool shades that will keep the sunlight out of your eyes. Don't wear them indoors.

items.name: Sunset Shutters
items.desc: Slatted lenses block sun, shame, and a surprising amount of doubt.

items.name: Adventurer's Pack
items.desc: Packed tight with rations, tools, and road-worn supplies.

items.name: Arcane Sigil
items.desc: Mystic wards glow beneath a polished jeweled crest.

items.name: Arrow Quiver
items.desc: Enough arrows to make confidence feel reasonable.

items.name: Blood Pendant
items.desc: A spiked heart charm that pulses too warmly.

items.name: Bomb Bud
items.desc: Back-mounted kaboom. Unstable, flashy, probably intentional.

items.name: Caged Spirit
items.desc: A spectral essence trapped within a twisted cage. Its glow flickers like a soul yearning for freedom.

items.name: Chronomancer's Codex
items.desc: The hourglass keeps terrible time, but the magic insists that is intentional.

items.name: Cursed Grimoire
items.desc: The lock breathes faintly, which most librarians consider a serious problem.

items.name: Hunter's Roll
items.desc: Rolled bedding says the road was planned even if everything else disagrees.

items.name: Iron Spire
items.desc: This chained spire looks like a chapel had armor problems.

items.name: Molten Core
items.desc: The cracked stone glows warmly, like a backpack pretending to be geology.

items.name: Obsidian Pillar
items.desc: Scrolls and charms weigh down magic that deserved supervision.

items.name: Ocular Grimoire
items.desc: The eye watches readers, which makes skimming feel personally judged.

items.name: Ornamented Staff
items.desc: Colorful charms clatter proudly, announcing a shamanic entrance.

items.name: Potion Bowl
items.desc: Brew tools wait inside, because battle sometimes needs emergency mana soup.

items.name: Potion Gourd
items.desc: Glowing brew sloshes quietly, praying that nobody will drink it too fast.

items.name: Satchel of Embers
items.desc: Alchemical firestones warm the pouch, and possibly burn your back.

items.name: Scroll Case
items.desc: Old scrolls stay sealed, safe, and less likely to complain.

items.name: Skull Lord Totem
items.desc: Horned skulls radiates dread before courage can gather.

items.name: Smith's Tools
items.desc: Hammers and tongs wait patiently for metal to misbehave.

items.name: Spiked Familiar
items.desc: Jagged limbs orbit nearby, humming like a tiny angry chandelier.

items.name: Spined Aegis
items.desc: Spikes crowd the relic's face, turning protection into warning signs.

items.name: Sun Disc
items.desc: Wooden sunlight rests warm against the back, gentle but alive.

items.name: Teapot Spirit
items.desc: A kettle-shaped charm that steams faintly. Rumored to house a mischievous spirit.

items.name: Tinkerer's Tools
items.desc: Fixing, tinkering, and improvising all jingle loudly from this belt.

items.name: Tome of Ages
items.desc: Old straps hold forgotten spells and histories that refuse retirement.

items.name: Traveler's Trunk
items.desc: A heavy wooden chest strapped for travel. Carries extra supplies or trade goods.

items.name: Treasure Chest
items.desc: Golden storage promises fortune.

items.name: Violet Heart Charm
items.desc: Purple warmth reassures the wearer, like a tiny magical blanket.
